svg.desc: Derived order (choices, depth) vs. a hand-encoded conventional school order. Red edges are violated dependencies. Dependency order only; no empirical claim.
svg.text: Two orders over one dependency graph
13 concepts, 23 justified edges (ATLAS_OF_N.md, DIGIT_CRYSTAL.md). Box shade = choices required. Red = violated dependency.
This is a dependency order. It is NOT a claim about how anyone learns.

svg.text: Colour steps are equal steps in the exact rational surrogate of runtime/render Sec.3, which is not perceptually uniform; and 'number of parameters' has no metric anyway.
The derived order's 0 violations is a theorem (curriculum/order.prove_topological), not a tuning result.
The conventional sequence is a MODEL written by hand in order.py. No curriculum document was read.
